India-Japan Higher Education Forum Held in Tokyo

The 3rd India-Japan Higher Education Forum for 2026 took place in Tokyo, hosted by O.P. Jindal Global University. The event focused on higher education collaboration between the two nations. This forum is part of ongoing efforts to strengthen academic ties.
